subject: Laptimes
author: FrozenVapor
body: I didn't use any glitches for any of my online laptimes. Most of my laps were earned with at least some pity boost, although not intentionally... it's just when you race like crap and fall behind, you have a chance to go for a lap. No taking each other down or anything like that, pity boost makes that unnecessary anyway.

subject: Sad but true...
author: SUFFUR
body:
I did this achievement way before it was available, got a good time too(not awesome), to match. And did do it regularyly (is this a word, now i will use Word, got it now, for spell check), as Evil Kon Karne, does this as a regular set up in his rooms.  Not that i could do it on a daily basis, but being first helps, for this one, or last as the other racers have killed most of the traffic, plus being last gives the pity boost for better times lol.

Thats a feature that should be done, by someone in the top 10, have we got any on the site? They should write about their protected rank😉, and what it is like to have times in the less than top 100 or even the top 10. Things like, did they use the glitch in White mountain or Angel Vally, did they get the times while in first, or use pity boost etc. Were the races so close that the rubber band effect never had a time to stretch, did you set up a six lap race, take each other down till the boost bars were full, then really race, without crashing? I would like to know as i've not taken it to the point of obsession, but some Burners have, i would like to hear your storys. The frustration of getting the best times in the world, then some b*stard, sorry friend, has taken you down on that last turn, i know Ivor (The God Father of the Boost Jump Technique, though i do know it was a room, joint effort, BlueMax etc help developed it as well as others) has some great times as well as Frozen Vapor and Sega, plus others. What is it like to be great on the game, and still try to kick ones own butt, and get even better?

Patience is something I taught myself, so I never know when its going to run out?

subject: Crashing when you think you will make it
author: Xandu
body:
LOL.. I know what you mean. This happens all the time to me when I'm going for good lap times. Had a flying lap on White Mountain forward... I'm thinging "SWEET.. this is going to be brilliant" as im flying across the bridge before the finish line... what do i do? Crash into incoming.. 1:48 with crash.. 😠 Then on Eastern Bay Long forward (or was it reverse?)... again flying... pretty much never going below 235.. following and catching up some really fast racer (he got 1:43:??...) Again I'm thinking "SWEET..." BOOOM.. crash into oncoming just before the finish line... Zombie was watching and she thought it was funny... Anyway that would probably have been a top 10 time on that lap. SO yeah! I know what you mean.

-- The Creator --
